thesis: Same untouched daily Donchian rules, restricted to the two most liquid coins. The first research run showed the rules cut the crash drawdown from 67% to 18% on an 11-coin basket that fell 57%; momentum is documented to be strongest in the most liquid coins and the altcoins were the drag.
risks: Only two correlated assets, so few trades and lumpy results; still long-only, so it earns nothing in a bear market beyond not losing; chosen after seeing one result, so treat a pass as a lead, not proof.
